title: Rivet route
description: Adds a file route (page) to a Rivet app: dynamic segments ([param], [[optional]], [...rest]), groups ((name)), optional load(…) / actions(…) / guard(…) exports and a folder layout.

path.description: Route path under src/routes: about, blog/[slug], docs/[[lang]]/[...path], (marketing)/pricing, blog/index.

loader.description: Add a load(…) export and a typed data prop.

action.description: Add an actions(…) export and a form that posts to it (node adapter only).

layout.description: Also create _layout.tsx in the route's folder (when it has none).
